title: 2002 HMMT February Guts Problem 45
statement: Find the number of sequences \(a_{1}, a_{2}, \ldots, a_{10}\) of positive integers with the property that \(a_{n+2}=a_{n+1}+a_{n}\) for \(n=1,2, \ldots, 8\), and \(a_{10}=2002\).

solutions.text: 3 Let \(a_{1}=a, a_{2}=b\); we successively compute \(a_{3}=a+b ; \quad a_{4}=a+\) \(2 b ; \quad \ldots ; \quad a_{10}=21 a+34 b\). The equation \(2002=21 a+34 b\) has three positive integer solutions, namely \((84,7),(50,28),(16,49)\), and each of these gives a unique sequence.
